summary: Implemented TimeElapsedColumn and the finished-time logic in rich/progress.py, the progress.elapsed style (yellow) in rich/default_styles.py, Palette.__rich__ in rich/palette.py, a CHANGELOG Unreleased entry, tests/test_palette.py (test_rich_cast), a new test_time_elapsed_column unit test, and the test_columns column-list and expected-output edits in tests/test_progress.py.
